 Key Highlights 
 The stock rebounded from a descending-channel lower band

 Fresh information published on October 30 has sharpened the market focus on Bajaj Finance.
 published reporting reported that Bajaj Finance had rebounded from the lower band of a descending channel after recovering from an intraday low near Rs 910 to close around Rs 939.
